name: Spark New Zealand Limited
summary: Spark New Zealand Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a telecommunications company in New Zealand. It operates through Cloud, IT Services Management, and Other Connectivity segments. The company offers telecommunications, information technology, and other digital products and services, including mobile services; broadband services; voice services; other connectivity; cloud services; IT services management; procurement and partner services; and business connectivity services.
